lenient.quote: Personal Agents MUST NOT send tokens or Session JWTs in a URL, and Companies MUST NOT accept them from one.
lenient.expected: The access_token query parameter ignored or refused, not checked as a token
lenient.cause: The endpoint read an access token from the URL and checked it. URLs end up in logs and browser history, so tokens are taken only from the Authorization header (5.6, RFC 6750 §2.3).

lenient.quote: An MCP server's challenges include resource_metadata with the server's protected resource metadata URL
lenient.expected: An initialize result, or 401 with WWW-Authenticate: Bearer resource_metadata="…"
lenient.cause: An MCP server answers initialize, or refuses a request without a token with a challenge that names its protected resource metadata.

lenient.quote: An MCP server's challenges include resource_metadata with the server's protected resource metadata URL
lenient.cause: An invalid access token gets 401 with invalid_token in the WWW-Authenticate header (RFC 6750 §3.1).

lenient.quote: Every event has an id, a type, and a created_at time
lenient.got: /events/8/message must include at least one of: text, data, context, operation, approval

lenient.quote: a message from either side, as it was sent, with role set by the Company to user or company for the side it came from
lenient.cause: A message event holds the message as it was sent, with its author, text, data, and context, plus role (8.5).
